title: Cal. Civ. Code § 1946.2 (just cause eviction)
requirement: A local ordinance adopted after September 1, 2019 that is less protective than this section shall not be enforced; any waiver of the rights under this section is void; and this section does not apply to a homeowner of a mobilehome.
coverage_conditions: Residential real property intended for human habitation, including units in mobilehome parks; does not apply to a homeowner of a mobilehome.
exemptions: Does not apply to a homeowner of a mobilehome as defined in Section 798.9.
quoted_span: after September 1, 2019, that is less protective than this section shall not be enforced unless this section is repealed.
interaction: State just cause law preempts less protective local ordinances adopted after September 1, 2019.
